mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_chatroom_s ( project_sq, company_sq, user_sq, chatroom_created_at, chatroom_user_is_deleted_yn, chatroom_company_is_deleted_yn ) VALUES ( #{projectSq}, #{companySq}, #{userSq}, NOW(), 'N', 'N' )
mapper.select: SELECT cr.chatroom_sq AS chatRoomSq, cr.project_sq AS projectSq, p.project_ttl AS projectNm, cr.company_sq AS companySq, c.company_nm AS companyNm, cr.user_sq AS userSq, ur.user_nm AS userNm, cr.chatroom_created_at AS chatroomCreatedDt, cr.last_message AS lastMsg, cr.last_message_at AS lastMsgAt, cr.chatroom_user_is_deleted_yn AS chatroomUserDeletedYn, cr.chatroom_company_is_deleted_yn AS chatroomCompanyDeletedYn, cr.user_lastmessage_sq AS userLastReadMsgSq, cr.company_lastmessage_sq AS companyLastReadMsgSq FROM tbl_chatroom_s cr JOIN tbl_project_m p ON cr.project_sq = p.project_sq JOIN tbl_company_s c ON cr.company_sq = c.company_sq JOIN tbl_user_m ur ON cr.user_sq = ur.user_sq WHERE cr.chatroom_sq = #{chatRoomSq}

SELECT cr.chatroom_sq AS chatRoomSq, cr.project_sq AS projectSq, p.project_ttl AS projectNm, cr.company_sq AS companySq, c.company_nm AS companyNm, cr.user_sq AS userSq, ur.user_nm AS userNm, cr.chatroom_created_at AS chatroomCreatedDt, cr.last_message AS lastMsg, cr.last_message_at AS lastMsgAt, cr.chatroom_user_is_deleted_yn AS chatroomUserDeletedYn, cr.chatroom_company_is_deleted_yn AS chatroomCompanyDeletedYn, cr.user_lastmessage_sq AS userLastReadMsgSq, cr.company_lastmessage_sq AS companyLastReadMsgSq FROM tbl_chatroom_s cr JOIN tbl_project_m p ON cr.project_sq = p.project_sq JOIN tbl_company_s c ON cr.company_sq = c.company_sq JOIN tbl_user_m ur ON cr.user_sq = ur.user_sq WHERE cr.user_sq = #{userSq} AND cr.chatroom_user_is_deleted_yn = 'N' ORDER BY cr.last_message_at DESC, cr.chatroom_created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_chatroom_s WHERE user_sq = #{userSq} AND chatroom_user_is_deleted_yn = 'N'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_chatroom_s WHERE company_sq = #{companySq} AND chatroom_company_is_deleted_yn = 'N'
